proposal: Single-storey rear extension to a terraced house

pages.text:
Site: 16 Linnet Row, Eastmere
Dwelling: end-terrace, 2 bedrooms
Proposal: single-storey rear extension, garden room

Revision B, 9 October 2026.
The rear extension projects 3.0 m beyond the rear build-
ing line of No. 14 and 4.6 m beyond the original rear wall of No. 16.
A daylight study for No. 18's kitchen window is attached as Appendix 2.

Vertical sky component at No. 18 kitchen window: 29% existing, 27% proposed.
The reduction is 7% of the existing value, below the 20% guideline.
